name: @repl/desktop
description: Adaptador de desktop do Harness: interface de tres colunas (Electron), renderer sem logica de agente nem estado duravel.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.gen:protocol: cd core && go run github.com/gzuidhof/tygo@v0.2.21 generate --config tygo.yaml
scripts.check:protocol: pnpm gen:protocol && { git diff --exit-code -- src/desktop/protocol/generated.ts || { echo 'src/desktop/protocol/generated.ts esta velho: rode pnpm gen:protocol'; exit 1; }; }
scripts.gate: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm gate:core
